# GitFlix — Netflix for GitHub Repositories
> Discover, explore, and monetize GitHub repos through a Netflix-style interface

## What is GitFlix?
GitFlix is a free, open-source platform that lets developers browse GitHub's 420M+ repositories
through a Netflix-style visual catalog. AI-powered recommendations, 10 curated categories,
instant search, and repo detail views with README previews.

## Key Features
- Netflix-style horizontal carousels for repo browsing
- 10 categories: Trending, AI/ML, MCP Servers, Web3, DevTools, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Security, CLI
- Repo detail page with README, stats, topics, download links
- Zero backend — pure GitHub API, no auth needed
- Mobile responsive, PWA ready
- AI discoverable (llms.txt, robots.txt)

## Tech Stack
- React 19, TypeScript, Vite
- GitHub REST API (public, no token)
- Deployed on GitHub Pages (free)
